# {{< var name >}}

**{{< var role >}}**  
{{< var affiliation >}}

I study how large-scale brain networks reorganize over time, with a focus on **EEG phase synchronization**, **metastability**, and **individual differences in cognition**. My work combines signal processing, network dynamics, dimensionality reduction, and statistical modeling.

[Research](research.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [Publications](publications.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary} [CV](cv.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-secondary}
:::

::: {.home-grid}
::: {.home-block}
## Research focus

**Metastable brain dynamics**  
Quantifying temporal variability and diversity of EEG synchronization networks using MSI and SCE.

**Brain-state representations**  
Characterizing high-dimensional phase-synchronization patterns with interpretable and nonlinear state-space methods.

**Individual differences**  
Relating dynamic network properties to cognitive traits and learning-related behavior.
:::

::: {.home-block}
## Methods

EEG preprocessing · complex Morlet wavelets · CSD · phase synchronization · network analysis · permutation statistics · PCA · NMF · ICA · UMAP · clustering · HMM

## Open science

I develop reusable MATLAB analysis code for EEG metastability and phase-synchronization dynamics.
